2_the_cut_is_STRUCTURAL_not_a_level_cut.consequence: The ANTI-CYCLICAL carry that earned the RISK_PREMIUM admission has been replaced by a PRO-CYCLICAL one. This is the single most important finding: it is not a 20% haircut to a floor, it is the removal of the floor property itself.

recourt_20260805.edge_explainer: The name was admitted as a RISK_PREMIUM CARRY - a quality UK housebuilder paying ~10.6% return of capital behind a hard GBP250M floor that did not deflate with the cycle. On 2026-07-31 the issuer withdrew exactly that. The floor is now 2% of net assets: a percentage that ratchets DOWN as net assets fall, which they already are. Committed cash yield is 2.90%, below gilts. Strip the carry and what remains is a cyclical at 0.71x tangible book earning 5.3% on that book - which justifies 0.47x, not 0.71x. The asset floor is not a floor; it is a premium to trough value being paid for a cycle turn the company itself just said is further away than it thought. Our own interim note doubled the surviving dividend and anchored a trim rung on it; correcting that arithmetic removes the last reason to hold. Edge ~0, tail unbounded, thesis void: exit.
